subsystems.name: Iron anode
subsystems.role: stores energy as plain iron metal; on discharge the iron oxidises, on charge it is plated back.
parts: additives to suppress unwanted hydrogen gas

subsystems.name: Air cathode
subsystems.role: breathes oxygen from the air and reduces it during discharge, releasing it on charge.

subsystems.name: Electrolyte and separator
subsystems.role: carries ions between the electrodes while keeping them apart; alkaline solution is typical.

subsystems.name: Cell housing
subsystems.role: holds the electrodes and lets air in without letting the electrolyte dry out or leak.

subsystems.name: Module and air handling
subsystems.role: many cells stacked together, with the airflow and pumps they need to work.

subsystems.name: Power conversion
subsystems.role: connects the DC battery to the AC grid and manages charge and discharge.

buildSteps.title: Make the iron powder
buildSteps.detail: Iron ore is reduced to sponge iron, then milled to a fine, consistent powder — the same industrial base as steelmaking.

buildSteps.title: Form the anode
buildSteps.detail: Iron powder is mixed with binders and additives and pressed or pasted onto a conductive mesh to make a porous electrode.

buildSteps.title: Make the air cathode
buildSteps.detail: Carbon, a catalyst and a hydrophobic binder are rolled or coated into a thin porous sheet that air can reach but electrolyte cannot leak through.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the cell
buildSteps.detail: Anode, separator and air cathode are stacked, wetted with alkaline electrolyte and sealed into a housing with air access.

buildSteps.title: Stack cells into modules
buildSteps.detail: Cells are packed into modules with manifolds for air and electrolyte, plus sensors for voltage and temperature.

buildSteps.title: Add balance of plant
buildSteps.detail: Blowers, pumps and a battery management system are fitted so the module can breathe and cycle safely.

buildSteps.title: Connect to the grid
buildSteps.detail: Modules are wired through bidirectional inverters and transformers to a substation for charging and discharging.

buildSteps.title: Cycle and validate
buildSteps.detail: The system is run through repeated charge and discharge cycles to measure how capacity fades before wider deployment.

prerequisites.tech: Cheap iron powder and steel supply chains
prerequisites.why: the whole point of the chemistry is that iron is abundant and already made at enormous scale.
plating iron back efficiently is hard: unwanted hydrogen evolution and shape change have limited cycle life for decades.
one electrode must both reduce and evolve oxygen over thousands of cycles without clogging or losing its catalyst.

prerequisites.tech: Utility-scale power conversion and grid controls
prerequisites.why: long-duration storage only has value if it can be charged and dispatched on demand, matching inverters and grid software.
the chemistry is cheap on paper; the cost only falls if porous electrodes can be made on production lines at scale.

pathway.unlocks: real operating data on round-trip efficiency, air handling and early capacity fade.

pathway.milestone: first commercial farms of roughly 100-hour duration
pathway.unlocks: a storage product that can ride through wind and solar lulls lasting days, which lithium-ion is too expensive to cover.

pathway.milestone: manufacturing scale-up and years of cycle-life evidence
pathway.unlocks: bankable projects and a credible cost per kilowatt-hour of stored energy.

pathway.milestone: wide deployment for multi-day and seasonal balancing
pathway.unlocks: firm renewable power without gas backup — though round-trip efficiency stays low, so it competes on cheap energy in, not on efficiency.
